column1: # G1 allowlist: every load read in the limit-recover rail, by enclosing function (tests/lr-guarantee-g1-lint.bats).
# Columns: path<TAB>enclosing-function<TAB>class<TAB>reason/owner. Anchored on function names, never line numbers.
# Python names are qualified (Class.method); <top> is code outside any function.
#   telemetry: the reading is recorded or printed and decides nothing.
#   capped-bound-stretch: the reading lengthens a bound, and the function shows its cap (python `return min(`, shell min( or an awk clamp).
#   env-off: the call's env comes from that lr_recon builder, which sets CC_ADMIT_LOAD_TERM off, and a test proves it.
#   debt: a real load-dependent decision with a named owner; printed on every run, and RESOLVED when it no longer matches.
